import sqlite3


def main():
    connection = sqlite3.connect("inventory.db", isolation_level=None)
    try:
        connection.execute("BEGIN")
        connection.execute(
            "UPDATE products SET quantity = ? WHERE name = ?",
            (8, "Widget"),
        )
        connection.execute(
            "INSERT INTO products (id, name, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET name = excluded.name, quantity = excluded.quantity",
            (4, "Doodad", 3),
        )
        connection.execute("DELETE FROM products")
        connection.commit()
        print(
            connection.execute(
                "SELECT id, name, quantity FROM products ORDER BY id"
            ).fetchall()
        )
    except Exception:
        connection.rollback()
        raise
    finally:
        connection.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
